description: This file contains debug function declarations for nl80211 Wi-Fi interface information, including functions to dump interface, wiphy, station, and all station info into variant maps for debugging purposes. It also includes licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpIfaceInfo
methods.description: Dumps interface info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpWiphyInfo
methods.description: Dumps wiphy info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps station info into a variant map for debugging.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpAllStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps all stations info into a map tree for debugging.
